name: Threads

disclosure.zh: Threads 用 Meta 的「AI 信息」标签。正文最多 500 字；每条只有一个话题标签（在编辑框里加，不显示 #），这里不会自动填。视频最长 5 分钟。
disclosure.en: Threads uses Meta's "AI info" label. Post text up to 500 characters; one topic tag per post (added in the composer, shown without #) - not filled here. Video up to 5 minutes.

guide.zh: 在 Threads 首页点发帖框，应用会放入视频并填好正文。需要的话自己加一个话题，再由你点「发布」。
guide.en: Open the composer on Threads; the app adds the video and types the text. Add one topic if you want, then press Post yourself.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
Sign-in goes through Instagram; the domain moved from threads.net to threads.com in 2025-04.
